evidence_quotes.O: From the moment you unpack the Oppo BDP-83 Universal Blu-Ray player you realize that this is going to be a truly unique experience.
evidence_quotes.C: I spent about 30 hours researching a replacement that would satisfy my goals of (a) compact size, (b) standard AA batteries, (c) full manual controls
evidence_quotes.E: I've since purchased a Harmony 668 for another setup, and have recommended various Harmony remotes to my friends.
evidence_quotes.A: However, several surprising configuration limitations keep me from giving it a full-on 5-star review.
evidence_quotes.N: my trusty Olympus D40-Zoom died - luckily at the end of a vacation.
